name: host
description: The runtime host's own tunable values: the caps, timeouts and queue depths it spends on behalf of every cartridge it composes.

stream_history_events.doc: Events retained per stream channel for replay.

stream_history_bytes.doc: Bytes retained per stream channel; the older bound wins.

subscriber_headroom.doc: Queue slots a subscriber gets beyond a full replay: the join, an optional gap, and room to be told it lagged.

outbox_queue.doc: Depth of the host's event outbox before a slow consumer is told it lagged.

lifecycle_queue.doc: Depth of the runtime's lifecycle broadcast.

lifecycle_drain_ms.doc: How long a lifecycle drain waits for one more event before concluding the burst ended.

startup_timeout_secs.doc: How long a process cartridge has to announce itself. RPC calls after that have no deadline.

startup_bytes.doc: Bytes of announcement a starting cartridge may write before the host stops reading.

discovery_bytes.doc: Bytes a `hello` discovery run may print.

shutdown_timeout_secs.doc: How long a disposed child gets to exit before it is reaped.

verify_timeout_secs.doc: How long `verify` waits for a composition to settle before calling it stuck.

watch_debounce_ms.doc: How long the source watcher gathers further changes before reloading.

daemon_wait_attempts.doc: Connection attempts a client makes while a daemon is coming up.

mcp_reply_queue.doc: Replies the MCP server may have in flight on this terminal's stdio.

proxy_key_bytes.doc: Entropy in a minted proxy key, in bytes.

sandbox_error_chars.doc: Characters of a sandbox failure's first line carried into the error.

observation_content_bytes.doc: Bytes of one observed payload that are hashed and recorded.

observation_cache_entries.doc: Observed sources kept in the resolution cache.

observation_actors_bytes.doc: Size of the actor map the environment may carry.

observation_source_chars.doc: Length of an observed source name.

lua_memory_bytes.doc: Bytes the host's Lua interpreter may allocate across every Lua cartridge; 0 is unbounded.

diagnostics_max_bytes.doc: Cap on the diagnostics file, with one rotated generation. `CARTRIDGE_DIAGNOSTICS_MAX_BYTES` overrides it for one invocation.
